title: Anchor labels to owners and resolve collisions in presentation
when: A label or degree value overlaps a source segment.
do: Bind label to the angle/point/relation it names.
Adjust label offset/leader within a bounded local region without moving source geometry.
check: Degree text avoids segment AB and still points to the intended AIB angle.
limitation: Daechi Q9 feedback identifies overlap; this space does not certify its live repair.
